name: Settsu Banri
source:
Leader of the Autumn Troupe.

"A super high-spec delinquent who can handle academics, sports, and pretty much everything else. Having not found a point to life, he always tried to pick fights until he tasted defeat for the first time. Having been defeated by Juza, he followed him into the MANKAI Company to seek revenge."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Banri_Settsu]A3! Wiki[/url]]
